parameters.name: valid

parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Instruction word; compressed instructions are shown in their decompressed 32-bit format (with `compr = 1`)

parameters.name: trap
parameters.description: Set if the current instruction causes a synchronous exception

parameters.name: halt
parameters.description: Set if the current instruction is last instruction before halting

parameters.name: intr
parameters.description: Set if the current instruction is the first instruction of a trap handler

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Current privilege level; `00` = user, `11` = machine

parameters.name: ixl
parameters.description: Current `XLEN`; hardwired to `01` = 32-bit

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Set if the current instruction is executed in debug-mode

parameters.name: compr
parameters.description: Set if the current instruction is a decompressed instruction

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: Set if the current instruction is the target of a control-flow transfer

parameters.description: register `rd` write data (_after_ instruction execution)

parameters.name: pc_wdata

parameters.description: CSR write data

parameters.name: mem_addr
parameters.description: memory access address

parameters.name: mem_rmask

parameters.name: mem_wmask
parameters.description: memory write-mask (byte-wise write-enable; all-zero if no memory write)

parameters.name: mem_rdata
parameters.description: memory read data (valid if `mem_rmask != 0`)

parameters.name: mem_wdata
parameters.description: memory write data (valid if `mem_wmask != 0`)
